The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC), through its General Administration Department, has released two important notices dated 7 September 2026 concerning the Direct Recruitment 2024 process for the post of Karyakari Sahayak (Executive Assistant). Notice MPR/921 lists candidates removed from the earlier Provisional Selection List No. 4 following document verification, while Notice MPR/964 provides a category-wise provisional status of candidates, including those found eligible, relatively eligible, pending, ineligible, or absent. Candidates who participated in the recruitment process should check these notices carefully using their roll number or application sequence number and follow any further instructions issued by BMC.

The Indian Air Force (IAF) officially declared the AFCAT Result 02/2026 on September 9, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) for the Flying Branch and Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical) branches can now check their qualifying status and download their scorecard from the official website, afcat.edcil.co.in. This recruitment cycle, Advertisement No. AFCAT 02/2026, covers 379 vacancies.

Direct Link to Check AFCAT 02/2026 Result 2026

How to Check AFCAT 02/2026 Result

  1. Visit the official AFCAT website: afcat.edcil.co.in.
  2. On the homepage, click the "AFCAT 02/2026 Result" link.
  3. You will be taken to a login page.
  4. Enter your User ID and Password.
  5. Type the Captcha code shown on screen.
  6. Click Sign In.
  7. Your AFCAT scorecard and result will appear on the screen.
  8. Download the scorecard and keep a printout for future reference.

Also Read: AIIMS NORCET 11 Admit Card 2026

What Is Mentioned in the AFCAT 02/2026 Scorecard

As per the official scorecard format, the AFCAT 02/2026 result document includes:

  • Candidate's Name
  • Roll Number
  • Category
  • Gender
  • Section-wise marks (Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning, General Awareness, Military Aptitude)
  • Total Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status
  • Cutoff Marks

What's Next After the AFCAT Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the AFCAT 02/2026 written exam move to the next stage of selection:

  1. AFSB Interview: Conducted by the Air Force Selection Board, this includes the Officer Intelligence Rating Test, Picture Perception and Discussion Test, Psychological Tests, Group Tests, and a Personal Interview.
  2. Document Verification: Verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and other relevant documents.
  3. Medical Examination: Candidates who clear the AFSB interview undergo a medical examination.

Documents to Keep Ready for Document Verification

  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Date of birth / age proof certificate
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS, where applicable)
  • AFCAT admit card and scorecard printout
  • Other documents as specified in the AFSB call letter

What to Do If You Did Not Qualify AFCAT 02/2026

  • Next AFCAT Cycle: The Indian Air Force conducts AFCAT twice a year. The next cycle, AFCAT 01/2027, is expected to be announced in December 2026.
  • No Attempt Limit: There is no cap on the number of AFCAT attempts, subject to meeting the age criteria for each cycle.
  • Review Your Scorecard: Check section-wise marks to identify weaker areas to focus on.
  • Practice: Solve previous years' AFCAT papers and take mock tests to improve speed and accuracy.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your AFCAT User ID and Password safe for logging in to check the result and, later, the AFSB call letter.
  • Check both your inbox and spam/junk folder for any OTP-related email from the official portal.
  • Download and save a printed copy of the scorecard once the result is displayed.
  • Rely only on the official website, afcat.edcil.co.in, for authentic updates on the AFSB interview schedule.

  5. The result PDF will open, listing all shortlisted roll numbers.

What Happens After the RBI Grade B Mains Result?

Shortlisted candidates move to the Interview stage, followed by a Personality Assessment. RBI has specified the following process:

  • Interview Call Letter: Sent by email from [email protected]. Candidates must check their registered email inbox, including spam/junk folders, regularly.
  • Personality Assessment: A link and instructions will be emailed to shortlisted candidates, to be completed within 5 days of receipt.
  • Interview Schedule: Date, time, and venue will be communicated via the call letter. Not Yet Announced separately on the website.
  • No Change Requests: Requests to change the interview date, time, or venue will not be entertained.

Event Date
Notification Release 18 June 2026

How to Download SBI PO Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official SBI Careers Portal at sbi.bank.in/web/careers, or use the direct login link shared above.
  2. Look for the notice "Call Letter for Preliminary Examination" under the Probationary Officer 2026 recruitment section (Advt No. CRPD/PO/2026-27/09).
  3. Click on the link and select your preferred admit card language.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code shown on screen and click Submit/Login.
  6. Your SBI PO Prelims Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen.
  7. Check every detail printed on it carefully.
  8. Download and take a clear printout for the exam day.

Details Printed on the SBI PO Admit Card

  • Candidate's name and photograph
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and complete address
  • Signature of the candidate
  • Important exam-day instructions and do's and don'ts

What to Carry to the SBI PO Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the SBI PO Prelims Admit Card 2026
  • One valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence)
  • Photocopy of the same photo ID proof
  • Passport-size photograph (as specified on the admit card)

Candidates are advised not to apply mehendi, ink, or any external chemical substance on their hands, since SBI captures a digital thumb impression for biometric verification. Any mismatch during verification can lead to rejection of candidature.

Important Instructions for SBI PO Admit Card 2026

  • The admit card is issued online only; SBI does not send it by post or courier.
  • No candidate will be permitted entry to the exam hall without a valid printed admit card.
  • The call letter is available online only from 22 July 2026 to 2 August 2026. Download and print it well before the closure date, as access may not be possible afterward.
  • Check your exam centre, date, and reporting time carefully as soon as the admit card is downloaded.
  • In case of any discrepancy in your name, photograph, or other details, contact the SBI CRPD helpline mentioned in the official notification immediately.
  • Do not rely on unofficial websites for downloading the admit card; use only the official SBI Careers Portal or the verified link.
  • Separate admit cards are issued for Prelims, Mains, and Phase III (Psychometric Test, Group Exercise, and Interview).

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notice for the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) Examination 2026, inviting online applications for Lower Division Clerk (LDC)/Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) and Data Entry Operator (DEO)/DEO Grade 'A' posts. SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 offers approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies across various Ministries, Departments, and Offices of the Government of India. Applications open on 07 September 2026 and close on 07 October 2026.

In short: SSC is recruiting for LDC/JSA and DEO posts under CHSL 2026, with about 2,536 tentative vacancies. Candidates who have passed Class 12 (or an equivalent exam) from a recognised board can apply. Online applications open on 07 September 2026 and close on 07 October 2026, with fee payment allowed until 08 October 2026. The application mode is online only, via the SSC website or the SSC mobile app, and the posts are located across various Central Government offices in India.

SSC CHSL Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Eligibility for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is assessed as on the cut-off date of 07 October 2026, and covers nationality, educational qualification, and age.

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from certain specified countries with the intention of settling permanently in India (candidates in the latter categories require an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).

SSC CHSL Qualification

Post Qualification Required
DEO/DEO Grade 'A' in Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, SSC, and Ministry of Culture 12th Standard pass in Science stream with Mathematics as a subject, from a recognised Board
LDC/JSA and DEO/DEO Grade 'A' (all other Departments/Ministries) 12th Standard pass or equivalent examination from a recognised Board or University

Candidates who have appeared for their Class 12 exam can also apply, but they must have the qualifying result declared on or before 07 October 2026. Only a declared result counts - a result "under process" does not meet the requirement.

SSC CHSL Age Limit

The age limit for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 27 years, reckoned as on 01 August 2026. This means candidates born not before 02 August 1999 and not later than 01 August 2008 are eligible to apply. Age relaxation is available as per government norms.

SSC CHSL Selection Process

Tier-II

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates with equivalent qualification from any other board are not eligible.
Local Language Must have studied the local language (as prescribed post-wise for each Circle in Annexure-III of the notification) at least up to 10th standard from a recognized board. Special provisions apply for Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Sikkim, and Nagaland.
Other Qualifications Knowledge of computers; knowledge of cycling; and adequate means of livelihood besides the GDS allowances (to be submitted as undertakings at the time of engagement)

Note: Past experience or service of any kind is not considered for selection, as per the notification.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

The fee, once paid, is non-refundable, and payment must be completed strictly within the application closing date and time (up to 1700 hrs).

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission
  7. Pay the applicable fee (if not exempted) through the available online payment modes within 10 minutes of initiating payment
  8. Submit the application on or before the last date, and use the two-day edit/correction window (23-24 September 2026) if any corrections are needed

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate; multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited and will result in cancellation of candidature
  • Candidates are not required to upload documents with the application, only their photograph and signature; original documents are verified physically at a later stage
  • Name, Date of Birth, Father's name, and Mother's name must be entered exactly as recorded in the Class 10 (Matriculation) certificate, failing which candidature may be cancelled
  • Mobile number and email ID, once registered, cannot be modified under any circumstances
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsorily retired from Government service/GDS in the past as a penalty are barred from applying and must submit an undertaking to this effect
  • SSE marksheets of selected candidates may be verified through DigiLocker/API Setu, and candidates must give consent for this verification
  • Candidates dismissed/removed/retired from Government service in the past as a penalty are barred from applying; a false declaration will lead to termination and possible prosecution
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement
  • The Department does not make phone calls to applicants; all correspondence is through the Engaging Authority only, and applicants should be cautious of unscrupulous calls seeking personal information
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason

SSC JE Vacancy 2026

SSC has notified 1748 tentative vacancies for the Junior Engineer Examination 2026. SSC JE Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

To apply for SSC JE 2026, candidates must meet the nationality, educational qualification, and age criteria prescribed for the post and organization they are applying to.

Nationality/Citizenship

  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A subject of Bhutan, or

SSC JE Qualification

Essential educational qualifications differ by organization and post. Broadly:

  • JE (Civil): Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute; or a three-year diploma in Civil Engineering plus relevant work experience (requirement varies by organization).
  • JE (Electrical) / JE (Mechanical) / JE (Electrical & Mechanical): Degree or diploma in the relevant Electrical/Mechanical/Automobile engineering discipline from a recognized university/institute, with experience required in some organizations.
  • JE (Telecom): Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical Communications, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or Instrumentation.
  • Scientific Assistant (IMD): Bachelor's degree in Science with Physics as one of the subjects, or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering/Instrumentation/Information Technology/Telecommunication Engineering/Communication Engineering.

Because the exact qualification differs organization by organization (for example, CPWD requires a diploma while BRO accepts a degree or diploma-plus-experience), candidates should check the qualification listed against their target organization in the official notice before applying. Qualifications obtained through Open and Distance Learning (ODL)/online mode in restricted disciplines such as Engineering are not accepted unless specifically permitted under applicable UGC regulations or judicial orders.

SSC JE Selection Process

Selection for SSC JE 2026 is based on the following stages:

  1. Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) – Qualifying in nature. Covers General Intelligence & Reasoning (50 questions/50 marks), General Awareness (50 questions/50 marks), and the relevant engineering/technical subject based on the post applied for (100 questions/100 marks). Total duration is 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for a scribe). Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.
  2. Paper-II (Computer Based Examination) – For candidates shortlisted from Paper-I. Covers the relevant engineering/technical subject in depth (100 questions/300 marks) in 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates). Negative marking of 1 mark applies for each wrong answer.
  3. Document Verification (DV) – Provisionally selected candidates must produce original certificates (educational qualification, category, age proof, experience, etc.) for verification by the concerned user department/organization.
  4. Physical Standards and Medical Examination – Applicable specifically for posts under organizations such as Border Roads Organisation (BRO)/GREF, as detailed in the relevant annexure of the notice.

Separate merit lists are prepared for JE (Civil), JE (Electrical & Mechanical), Scientific Assistant (IMD), and JE (Telecom). Both papers consist of objective-type, multiple-choice questions set in Hindi and English.

PGIMER Nursing Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

PGIMER Nursing Officer eligibility 2026 is based on educational qualification, professional registration, and (for some candidates) experience, along with the prescribed age limit.

PGIMER Nursing Officer Qualification

Candidates must possess one of the following qualification combinations:

  • Option A: B.Sc. (Hons) in Nursing from a recognized University or Institute, OR Regular course in B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University or Institute, OR Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University or Institute; AND Registered as a Nurse or Nurse and mid-wife (RN or RN & RM) with a State Nursing Council.
  • Option B: Diploma in General Nursing and Mid-wifery (GNM) from a recognized Board or Council; Registered as a Nurse or Nurse and mid-wife from a State Nursing Council; AND one year of experience in a minimum fifty-bedded hospital after acquiring the above qualification.

Unless diplomas/degrees obtained through Open and Distance Learning mode are recognized for the relevant period as per the Ministry of Education Notification dated 10.06.2015, they will not be accepted for the purpose of educational qualification.

PGIMER Nursing Officer Age Limit 2026

The age limit for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 35 years, calculated as on the last date of submission of the online application, i.e., 03.10.2026. Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate will be accepted; no subsequent request for change will be considered.

Payment through UPI may be avoided. The application fee is non-refundable, and no correspondence regarding refund of fee for erroneously filled applications will be entertained.

PGIMER Nursing Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection to the post of Nursing Officer will be made purely on the basis of a Computer Based Test (CBT); there is no interview for this Group 'B' (Non-Gazetted) post, as per Government of India instructions.

PGIMER Nursing Officer Qualifying Marks

  • General/EWS category: minimum 40% marks
  • SC/ST/OBC categories: minimum 35% marks
  • PwBD candidates: minimum qualifying marks as prescribed for their respective caste category (General/SC/ST/OBC)
  • Reserved category candidates applying against an unreserved (UR) post: minimum 40% for all categories

PGIMER Nursing Officer Selection Stages

  1. Computer Based Test (CBT): Objective-type MCQs as per the pattern above.
  2. Shortlisting: Candidates who qualify the CBT as per the minimum qualifying criteria will be shortlisted category-wise. The number of candidates shortlisted will be 3 times the number of advertised posts (plus ties), for further scrutiny and document verification.
  3. Scrutiny of Applications: Applications of shortlisted candidates are checked against the applicable recruitment rules and uploaded documents.
  4. Provisional Result (Selected/Waitlisted): Declared based on merit in the CBT for candidates found eligible by the scrutiny committee.
  5. Document Verification: Provisionally selected/waitlisted candidates are called for in-person document verification with original certificates.
  6. Final Selection: Made purely on merit based on CBT marks, after documents are found in order.

How to Apply for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026

PGIMER Nursing Officer Apply Online process is entirely online; no offline application form or downloaded/printed application copy will be accepted.

  2. Complete Online Registration by filling mandatory details: Advertisement Number, Advertisement Date, Name of Applicant (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth (as per matriculation certificate), Mobile Number, and Email ID. These details cannot be changed once registered.
  3. Login using the User ID and password received on the registered email and mobile number, then click "Go to Application Form".
  4. Fill the section-wise Application Form covering personal information, qualification(s), experience(s), and upload of documents/certificates. Use "Save and Next" to move between sections.
  5. Upload a recent, unattested, scanned photograph in JPG/JPEG format (50–80 KB), snapped on or after 1st July 2026, with the candidate's name and date of taking the photograph clearly visible on it.
  6. Upload legible scanned copies of certificates/documents supporting educational qualification (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD, where applicable), experience certificate(s), and NOC from present employer (if employed).
  7. Indicate your preferred examination city carefully, as it cannot be changed later.
  8. Click Submit after completing all sections, and proceed to pay the applicable application fee through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.

  • Candidates are prohibited from carrying mobile phones, wrist watches, wallets, jewellery, or any electronic device into the examination hall.

  • There is no provision for re-checking or re-evaluation of answer sheets.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages of the recruitment process and can be cancelled at any stage if found ineligible.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant.

BCPL Non Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Candidates meeting all eligibility criteria (as declared in the online Application Form) will be considered for further Selection Process.
  • Depending on the number of eligible applicants, the process may involve a single stage or multiple stages. If the number of applications is very high, BCPL may raise the minimum eligibility standards to shortlist candidates.
  • The Selection Process shall consist of Skill Test / Proficiency Test / Endurance Test / Written Test, and the exact process will be communicated in advance to shortlisted candidates.
  • The selection process indicated is tentative and may vary depending on administrative/ business requirements or Government of India directives.
  • Candidates must meet the prescribed medical fitness standards. Eye power criteria: for technical officers, total myopia should not exceed (-)4.00D and hypermetropia should not exceed (+)4.00D in each eye; for non-technical officers, myopia should not exceed (-)8.00D and hypermetropia should not exceed (+)6.00D (for candidates above 20 years).
  • No travelling expenses are payable to candidates called for the written test.

How to Apply for BCPL Non Executive Recruitment 2026

  1. Applications must be submitted online only through the official BCPL website: www.bcplonline.co.in. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  2. Candidates can apply for ONE post only. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the one submitted on the later date will be considered.
  3. Before applying, candidates should keep the following ready:
    • A valid e-mail ID (must remain active for at least one year; cannot be changed later)
    • A recent passport-size photograph and signature in digital form (.jpg/ .jpeg, under 50 KB)
    • Digital copies (.jpg/ .pdf, max 200 KB) of proof of age, SC/ ST/ EWS certificate, Benchmark Disability certificate (for PwBD), Ex-Servicemen certificate, mark sheets/ qualification certificates, and post-qualification experience certificates, as applicable.
  4. After submitting the application, candidates must download the system-generated Pay-in Slip and Registration Slip.
  5. Candidates are not required to submit a hard copy of the application form to BCPL.
  6. If shortlisted for the further Selection Process, candidates must carry the downloaded Application Form, original documents, and one self-attested photocopy set, including proof of date of birth, caste/ tribe certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), ex-servicemen proof (if applicable), all qualification certificates from matriculation onward, and complete experience certificates as specified in the notification.
  7. Candidates employed in Central/ State Government, PSEs, or Autonomous Bodies must forward their application through the proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the Selection Process.

Important General Instructions

  • The prescribed qualification/ experience represents the minimum standard only and does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for further selection.
  • Details entered at the time of registration are final; requests to change mailing address, email ID, category, or post declared in the application will not be entertained.
  • Category (SC/ ST/ OBC-NCL/ EWS/ PwBD) once selected in the application cannot be changed later, and no benefit of another category will be given subsequently.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer are not entitled to OBC concessions and must indicate their category as "General."
  • Furnishing false or incorrect information at any stage will lead to summary rejection of candidature, or termination of service if detected after appointment.
  • BCPL reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards, and to fill, not fill, cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or alter the recruitment/ selection process without prior notice.
  • Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Dibrugarh Court only, and the English version will prevail in case of any interpretation dispute with other language versions.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, or corrigendum to this advertisement will be published only on the "Careers" section of www.bcplonline.co.in.

The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Policy Division, New Delhi has released CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 notifications inviting applications from eligible advocates for engagement as Special Public Prosecutor (SPP) to conduct trial of Lokpal-referred CBI cases pending before the Special Judge, CBI, Ghaziabad. Separate advertisements have been issued for panel engagement to conduct trial at the Special Judge, CBI courts at Lucknow, Jabalpur, Ghaziabad, and Coimbatore. This CBI Recruitment 2026 notice consolidates all four location-wise advertisements, which carry identical eligibility, fee and application terms.

  • CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Notification Coimbatore
  • CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Notification Ghaziabad
  • CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Notification Jabalpur
  • CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Notification Lucknow

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Overview

Recruiting Authority Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Policy Division, New Delhi
Post Special Public Prosecutor (SPP), CBI - to conduct trial of Lokpal-referred CBI cases
Trial Court Locations Special Judge, CBI courts at Lucknow, Jabalpur, Ghaziabad, and Coimbatore (separate advertisement for each location)
Who Can Apply Eligible advocates with LLB qualification, Bar Council enrollment, and minimum 10 years' standing with criminal-matter experience at the Bar (see Eligibility section)
Engagement Period Minimum 3 years
Application Mode Online only, through the prescribed proforma and online link
Application Last Date 08 October 2026 (all four locations)
Selection Mode Shortlisted candidates called for an interaction by CBI; no written exam specified
Professional Fee Governed by DoPT File No. 225/19/2023-AVD-II dated 08.04.2024 (amount not specified in the notification provided)

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
DoPT File governing Professional Fee terms & conditions 08.04.2024

Last Date of Receipt of Online Applications (Jabalpur) 08 October 2026
Last Date of Receipt of Online Applications (Ghaziabad) 08 October 2026
Last Date of Receipt of Online Applications (Coimbatore) 08 October 2026

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Trial Court Locations

CBI Policy Division intends to create a panel of advocates for conducting trial of Lokpal-referred cases pending before the Special Judge, CBI, Ghaziabad. Separate, identically worded advertisements have been issued inviting applications for engagement as Special Public Prosecutor to conduct trial at each of the following courts:

Trial Court Nature of Job Engagement Period Last Date to Apply
Special Judge, CBI, Lucknow Conduct trial of cases pending under trial in the court of Special Judge, CBI, Lucknow Minimum 3 years 08 October 2026
Special Judge, CBI, Jabalpur Conduct trial of cases pending under trial in the court of Special Judge, CBI, Jabalpur Minimum 3 years 08 October 2026
Special Judge, CBI, Ghaziabad Conduct trial of cases pending under trial in the court of Special Judge, CBI, Ghaziabad Minimum 3 years 08 October 2026
Special Judge, CBI, Coimbatore Conduct trial of cases pending under trial in the court of Special Judge, CBI, Coimbatore Minimum 3 years 08 October 2026

The number of Special Public Prosecutor positions to be engaged at each location is not specified in the notification; CBI is creating a panel of advocates rather than advertising a fixed vacancy count.

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

The following eligibility criteria apply uniformly to all four CBI Special Public Prosecutor advertisements:

  • Educational Qualification: LLB.
  • Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council.
  • Experience at the Bar of handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts.
  • An unconditional willingness/consent to work on the general terms & conditions approved by the Government of India from time to time.
  • A minimum standing of 10 years as an Advocate is required for considering an advocate for CBI Special Public Prosecutor, along with details of important criminal cases handled by the applicant.
  • Experience in conducting trials of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, is a mandatory pre-condition.
  • Eligible candidates shall be required to be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated. No travelling allowance or reimbursement of travel expenses shall be admissible for attending the Court.

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Professional Fee

The Professional Fee of the advocates engaged as Special Public Prosecutor will be governed by the terms & conditions contained in DoPT File No. 225/19/2023-AVD-II dated 08.04.2024. The specific fee amount is not specified in the notification itself; a copy of the DoPT file is stated to be attached to the official advertisement.

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

 Eligibility is instead based on a minimum standing of 10 years as a practicing Advocate with relevant criminal-trial experience, as detailed in the Eligibility section above.

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Applications are submitted online along with the prescribed proforma and supporting documents; only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI. The proposal for engagement is also subject to approval, as recorded in the prescribed proforma, from DOP/CBI, the Director, CBI, and the Learned Attorney General.

How to Apply for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026

The complete application, in the prescribed proforma format, along with the requisite documents, should be submitted through the online link for the relevant trial court location.

  • Incomplete applications and applications submitted offline shall not be considered.
  • No application shall be entertained by CBI if submitted after the last date of submission.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI.
  • The last date of receipt of online applications is 08 October 2026 for all four locations (Lucknow, Jabalpur, Ghaziabad, Coimbatore).

Documents Required for CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026

The following documents may be submitted along with the application:

  • Educational Qualifications
  • Enrollment Certificate as an Advocate with the Bar Council
  • Experience at the Bar of handling criminal matters in Sessions Courts
  • An unconditional willingness/consent to work on the general terms & conditions approved by the Government of India from time to time
  • Details of important cases handled by the applicant advocate
  • Details of cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, handled by the applicant advocate

Applicants must also fill the prescribed Proforma for Appointment/Engagement of Special Public Prosecutor for CBI, which requires details including: name, date of birth, residence and office address, educational qualifications, date of enrolment as an Advocate, experience on the criminal side (at Bar, number of criminal cases handled, and cases appeared on behalf of CBI/Central Government/State Government departments, broken down by Subordinate Courts, High Courts and Supreme Court), a list of important cases handled (including under-trial cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988), cases where success was achieved, current workload, whether currently working as a Panel Lawyer/Standing Counsel/Legal Advisor for any Central or State Government Ministry/Department/Organisation, and the approval status of the proposal.

CBI Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 General Instructions

  • Eligible candidates shall be required to be stationed at the place where the concerned Court is situated; no travelling allowance or reimbursement of travel expenses shall be admissible for attending the Court.
  • Incomplete applications and applications submitted offline shall not be considered.
  • No application shall be entertained after the last date of submission.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interaction by CBI.
  • The document is marked "Confidential" by the CBI Policy Division.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)

Follow these steps to complete your forest department recruitment 2026 apply online process:

  1. Visit the official website of the respective state Forest Department or recruitment board (link provided in the notification table above)
  2. Register using your mobile number and email ID to generate login credentials
  3. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details
  4. Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and required certificates
  5. Pay the application fee online via net banking, debit card, or UPI (fee varies by category and state)
  6. Review all entered details carefully before final submission
  7. Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference

Documents Required & Application Fee

Documents required:

  • Passport-size photograph and signature (scanned, as per specified format)
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Date of birth proof (10th certificate or birth certificate)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable
  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applying under that quota
  • Domicile/residence certificate, where required by the state

Application fee: Typically ranges from ₹200–₹1,000 depending on the state and category, with fee concessions or exemptions commonly available for SC/ST, PwBD, and ex-servicemen candidates.

Every vacancy listed on this page is reviewed for important details including eligibility, age limit, application dates, selection process and official notification links before publication. We also update the page whenever new vacancies are announced or recruitment schedules change.

Bookmark This Page for Daily Forest Department Recruitment Updates

Forest Department vacancies are released by different states at different times throughout the year. Bookmark this page and visit regularly to stay updated with the latest Forest Guard Recruitment 2026, Forest Officer notifications, Beat Officer vacancies, Forester recruitment, application dates and official notification PDFs. FAQs - Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Q1: What is the latest forest department recruitment 2026?

The latest notifications include Forest Guard, Forester, Range Forest Officer, and Group C forest posts released by state forest departments, PSCs, and staff selection boards. Check the table above for live vacancies and last dates, updated daily.

Q2: What is the last date to apply for forest department recruitment 2026?

The application last date varies by state and recruiting body - it is listed against each notification in the table above under "Last Date to Apply." Always confirm the exact date on the official notification before applying.

Q3: What is the qualification for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Most Forest Guard and Field Guard posts require a 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board. Higher posts like Forester or Range Forest Officer typically need 12th pass, a graduate degree, or a degree in a science/forestry-related field.

Q4: Is there any age relaxation for ex-servicemen in forest department recruitment?

Yes. Jobs for ex-servicemen in the forest department usually come with reserved vacancies and additional age relaxation - typically 3 to 5 years beyond the standard age limit - along with relaxed physical standards in many states.

Q5: How can I apply online for forest department vacancy 2026?

Visit the official website of the respective state forest department or recruitment board, register with your basic details, fill in the application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee, and submit. Full step-by-step details are in the "How to Apply" section above.

Q6: Which states have active forest guard recruitment 2026 notifications?

States including West Bengal, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Himachal Pradesh, and Tripura currently have or regularly release forest guard and forest officer vacancies. See the state-wise section above for details on each.

Q7: What is the salary for forest guard and forest officer posts in 2026?

Forest Guard salary typically ranges from ₹28,000 to ₹35,000 gross per month under Pay Level 3, while Range Forest Officer and ACF posts range from ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 depending on pay level. Full breakdown is in the salary table above.

Q8: Is there a written exam for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Yes, most states conduct a written exam covering General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, and Mathematics, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and document verification before the final merit list is prepared.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

  6. Pay the application fee (if any) and submit before the last date.
  7. Save or print the confirmation for future reference.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks, 15th cycle (CRP RRBs-XV), inviting online applications for Group "A" Officer (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in India. IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online registration opens on 1 September 2026 and closes on 21 September 2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for Officer Scale-I, II (seven specialisations), III, and Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts, with an indicative 13,706 vacancies spread across 28 RRBs covering nearly every state and union territory of India. Graduates in any discipline (with specific additional qualifications for certain Officer Scale-II specialist roles) between 18 and 40 years of age (depending on the post) can apply online only, from 1 September 2026 to 21 September 2026, at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in.

  • IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • Direct link to apply for IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026
  • • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS), on behalf of 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
Recruitment Name Common Recruitment Process for RRBs (CRP RRBs-XV)
Posts Office Assistant (Multipurpose); Officer Scale-I, II & III
Total Vacancies 13,706 (indicative; see Vacancy Details section)
Application Mode Online only
Application Start Date 01.09.2026
Last Date to Apply 21.09.2026
Job Location Regional Rural Banks across 28 States/UTs of India
Official Website www.ibps.in

IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Activity Tentative Schedule
Online registration of application 01.09.2026 to 21.09.2026
Payment of application fee/intimation charges (online) 01.09.2026 to 21.09.2026
Edit window to modify/correct application form For 2 days after closure of registration (date to be notified on the official website)
Conduct of Pre-Exam Training (PET) November 2026
Call letter download - Preliminary exam (Officers/Office Assistant) November/December 2026
Online Examination - Preliminary (Officers/Office Assistant) November/December 2026
Result of Preliminary exam December 2026/January 2027
Call letter download - Main/Single exam December 2026/January 2027
Online Examination - Main/Single (Officers/Office Assistant) December 2026/February 2027
Declaration of result - Main/Single (Officer Scale I, II, III) January 2027
Call letter download - Interview (Officer Scale I, II, III) January 2027
Conduct of Interview (Officer Scale I, II, III) January/February 2027
Provisional Allotment (all posts) February/March 2027

IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details

IBPS has released indicative, RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies for each post in Annexure-I of the notification. The notification itself does not print a single consolidated grand-total figure; the totals below are computed by summing the individual state/RRB-wise tables for each post category. One participating bank, Tripura Gramin Bank, has reported "NR" (Not Reported) against every post, so it is excluded from these computed totals and the true final vacancy count will be higher once that figure is released.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts (computed total, indicative)
1 Office Assistant (Multipurpose) 8,183
2 Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) 4,256
3 Officer Scale-II (all specialisations combined: General Banking Officer, IT Officer, Chartered Accountant, Law Officer, Treasury Manager, Marketing Officer, Agricultural Officer) 1,047
4 Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) 220
Total (computed, excluding Tripura Gramin Bank's "NR" figures) 13,706

Vacancies are spread across all 28 participating RRBs, covering states such as Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and others. Candidates can check the RRB-wise, category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General) breakup for their state directly in Annexure-I of the official notification, since a state/category-level reproduction is too extensive for this summary.
