IBPS RRB Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

Nationality: a candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently in India, or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Educational qualification (as on the last date of online registration, i.e. 21.09.2026) varies by post:

Post Essential Educational Qualification Post-Qualification Experience
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent; proficiency in the local language prescribed by the participating RRB; working knowledge of computers is desirable Not required
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference to candidates with a degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, IT, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy; local language proficiency required Not required
Officer Scale-II - General Banking Officer Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds 2 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Information Technology Officer Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Communication/Computer Science/IT or equivalent, minimum 50% aggregate marks 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Chartered Accountant Certified Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 1 year as a Chartered Accountant
Officer Scale-II - Law Officer Degree in Law from a recognised university, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years as an advocate, or as a Law Officer in a bank/financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Treasury Manager Chartered Accountant, or MBA in Finance from a recognised university/institution 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Marketing Officer MBA in Marketing from a recognised university 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Agricultural Officer Bachelor's degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Dairy/Animal Husbandry/Forestry/Veterinary Science/Agricultural Engineering/Pisciculture, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the relevant field
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds Minimum 5 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution

Candidates awarded CGPA/OGPA must convert it to a percentage as per their university's own conversion criteria, and the result for the qualifying degree must have been declared on or before 21.09.2026.

IBPS RRB Age Limit

Age is reckoned as on 01.09.2026.

Post Age Limit
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) 18 to 28 years
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Above 18, below 30 years
Officer Scale-II (Manager) Above 21, below 32 years
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Above 21, below 40 years

Age relaxation is available as follows: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (non-creamy layer), 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), and additional relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and (for Office Assistant only) widows, divorced women, and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one other applicable category.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

IBPS RRB Application Fee

Category Fee (Officer Scale I/II/III) Fee (Office Assistant)
SC/ST/PwBD (and ESM/DESM for Office Assistant) ₹175 (inclusive of GST) ₹175 (inclusive of GST)
All other candidates ₹850 (inclusive of GST) ₹850 (inclusive of GST)

Payment is online only, between 01.09.2026 and 21.09.2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. A candidate applying for both an Officer post and the Office Assistant post must pay the fee separately for each.

Also Read: IOB Generalist/SO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 291 Manager, Assistant Manager and Senior Manager Posts

IBPS RRB Salary & Exam Pattern

Salary: Not specified in the notification.

Exam pattern: The online examination structure differs by post and stage.

Post Stage Sections Total Marks Duration
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Preliminary Reasoning, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 80 45 minutes
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Main Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 200 120 minutes
Officer Scale-III (Single-level exam) Single Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, Financial Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Data Interpretation 200 120 minutes

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the objective tests; unattempted questions are not penalised. Officer Scale-II candidates sit for a single-level examination (structure not itemised separately in the notification excerpt reviewed here beyond the general pattern above).

Also read: IBPS RRB Clerk Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026: Download PDF Here

IBPS RRB Selection Process

  • Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Provisional Allotment (based on Main Exam marks and actual vacancies reported by the RRB).
  • Officer Scale-I: Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Officer Scale-II & III: Single-level online exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Interview is out of 100 marks; minimum qualifying marks are 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates).
  • The relative weightage for Officer posts is 80% online exam and 20% interview.
  • Interviews for Officer posts are coordinated by the Nodal Regional Rural Bank with the assistance of NABARD and IBPS.

How to Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in, and open the "CRP for RRBs" link on the home page.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICERS (Scale-I, II and III)" or "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICE ASSISTANTS (Multipurpose)", as applicable.
  3. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by SMS/email).
  4. Log back in using the provisional registration number and password to complete the rest of the form.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, and your Class 10 (SSC/SSLC) certificate, plus any category/disability certificates applicable to you, as per the scanning specifications in Annexure-III.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online.
  7. Candidates applying for both Office Assistant and an Officer post, or reconsidering their choice of Officer scale, must register and pay separately for each post.
  8. Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

Documents Required

  • Printout of the valid interview call letter (for Officer posts)
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of date of birth (birth certificate or Class 10/SSLC certificate showing DOB)
  • Photo identity proof
  • Mark-sheets/certificates for the qualifying degree, with proof the result was declared on or before 21.09.2026
  • Experience certificate(s), where the post requires post-qualification experience
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL, in the prescribed Government of India format), where applicable
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, where applicable
  • Disability certificate/UDID card, where applicable
  • Ex-servicemen documents (discharge certificate/pension payment order, or the relevant proforma), where applicable

Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 notification for the appointment of 2482 Local Bank Officer (LBO) vacancies on a regular basis across 20 states of India. This BOB LBO Recruitment 2026 drive, issued under Advertisement No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16, invites applications from eligible Indian citizens who are graduates with at least one year of post-qualification experience as an officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank.

Candidates looking for BOB Local Bank Officer Vacancy 2026 details, eligibility, application fee, salary, and how to apply online can check the complete information below, based directly on the official Bank of Baroda notification.

Quick facts: Bank of Baroda is recruiting for the post of Local Bank Officer (JMG/S-I) with 2482 vacancies. Graduates in any discipline with a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification banking officer experience and proficiency in the local language of the state applied for can apply. Online registration starts on 18.08.2026 and closes on 17.09.2026. Applications must be submitted online through the Bank's official website, and selected candidates will be posted within the state they apply for.

BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India
Educational Qualification Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (mandatory)
Preferred Certifications IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
Post-Qualification Experience Minimum 1 year as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India
Language Proficiency Must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, understanding) in the local language of the state applied for

Candidates who have resigned from an officer-grade position in Bank of Baroda, or exited the Bank while on contract within the last three years as on the cut-off date, are not eligible to apply. Employees currently working in Bank of Baroda in the officer cadre or on contract basis are also not eligible.

BOB Local Bank Officer Salary 2026

Selected candidates for the JMG/S-I grade will draw pay as per the following scale, along with allowances and benefits as per the Bank's policies.

Grade Pay Scale
JMG/S-I 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920

One advance increment will be granted to selected candidates who have one year or more of work experience as an Officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. Salary and other emoluments will be governed by the industry-level bipartite settlement and Joint Note applicable to bank officers, along with bank-specific allowances and perquisites as revised from time to time.

BOB Local Bank Officer Application Fee

The non-refundable application fee/intimation charges for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 are as follows. Fees must be paid irrespective of whether the candidate is shortlisted or the online test is conducted.

Category Application Fee
General, EWS & OBC Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges
SC, ST, PWBD, ESM/DESM & Women Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

Payment can be made online through Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.

BOB Local Bank Officer Age Limit

The age limit indicated below is for General category candidates as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026.

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years

Age Relaxation:

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities Gen/EWS - 10 years, OBC - 13 years, SC/ST - 15 years
Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers (ECOs/SSCOs) with min. 5 years military service Gen/EWS - 5 years, OBC - 8 years, SC/ST - 10 years

There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' Cadre; only age relaxation as above applies. OBC candidates in the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation.

Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The tentative structure of the online examination is as follows:

Section Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
1 English Language 30 30 30 Minutes
2 Banking Knowledge 30 30 30 Minutes
3 General/Economic Awareness 30 30 30 Minutes
4 Reasoning Ability & Quantitative Aptitude 30 30 30 Minutes
- Total 120 120 120 Minutes

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

  • Bank of Baroda LBO Syllabus 2026

How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in
  2. Go to the Career section/webpage and click on "Current Opportunities".
  3. Register online and fill in the application form for Local Bank Officer.
  4. Upload the required documents, including scanned photograph, signature, resume, DOB proof, educational certificates, work experience certificates, and caste/PWBD certificate (if applicable).
  5. Verify all details carefully before submission, as no changes are allowed after clicking Submit.
  6. Pay the application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the completed application form and fee receipt for future reference.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Executive & Credit Analyst Eligibility Criteria

This Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 8 posts across Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I – Banking Operations) and Manager (Grade/Scale MM II – Internal Audit), against SC, ST, and OBC backlog vacancies. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. The online application link will be live from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026, and no other mode of application will be accepted. Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Vacancy 2026

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post.

Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) – Internal Audit (2 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent).

Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) – Banking Operations (6 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above.

Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures.

Other Eligibility Notes

  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process

Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Structure of Written Test

Name of Test Section No. of Questions Max. Marks Time
Professional Knowledge – Subjective Part I – Question 1 (Compulsory) 1 40 2 hours 30 minutes
Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions 6 (of 8) 60
Total 100 2 hours 30 minutes

There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm, colour, white/light background, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG

  • Deputy Managers must execute a personal bond of ₹3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or appear in the CIBIL defaulter database are not eligible to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai, with courts/tribunals in Mumbai having sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the recruitment process, including the number of vacancies, at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected may use a scribe at their own cost and arrangement, subject to the Bank's stipulated scribe guidelines, and will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination if registered for it in advance.

Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

Online registration for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 begins on 8th September 2026 and closes on 28th September 2026.

Eligible Indian citizens (and specified categories under Nationality rules) who meet the age and qualification criteria as on 30.06.2026 can apply online through the official website, uiic.co.in. Below is a complete breakdown of UIIC AO vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, application fee, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

UIIC AO Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the Nationality/Citizenship condition as on the date of application. A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the last four categories must hold an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

UIIC AO Qualification

The minimum educational qualification must have been obtained on or before 30.06.2026 from a recognised university or institute, approved by UGC/AICTE, through the 10+2+3 pattern or an equivalent system. Working knowledge of computers is mandatory for all candidates.

UIIC AO Age Limit

UIIC AO Salary

Selected candidates will draw basic pay in the scale of ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, along with other admissible allowances. In addition to emoluments, the Company provides Gratuity, LTS, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and National Pension System (NPS), with leased accommodation extended as per Company rules. Gross pay is approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres.

Selected candidates will serve a probation period of one year (extendable at the Company’s discretion) and must pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India during probation. Candidates must also execute a guarantee bond to serve the Company for a minimum of five years, including the probation period; early resignation attracts liquidated damages plus a ₹35,000 onboarding and integration cost.

UIIC AO Selection Process

Selection for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview.

  • Tier I – Preliminary Examination (Qualifying, 100 marks, 60 minutes): English Language (30 questions/30 marks), Reasoning (35/35), Quantitative Aptitude (35/35).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Generalists: Objective Test of 250 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness with special reference to the Financial Sector, and Computer Knowledge – 200 questions, 150 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 30 marks (Letter Writing and Essay, 30 minutes).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Hindi Officers: Objective Test of 200 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Professional Knowledge of Hindi/English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge – 150 questions, 120 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 50 marks (English/Hindi essay, letter writing, and translation, 60 minutes).
  • Interview: Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for interview, up to three times the vacancies in the respective category/discipline.

For Generalists, the final merit list is prepared using Main Examination Objective Test marks and Interview marks in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary and Descriptive Test marks are not counted for merit. For Hindi Officers, the Main Examination (Objective + Descriptive) and Interview marks are considered in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary Examination marks are not counted for merit. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in the objective tests.

Detailed Job Descriptions 

Field Collection Officer / Collection FOS (DRA Certified)

Supports Bank of Baroda's receivable management and recovery operations through field visits and customer interactions for timely recovery of overdue payments, in compliance with RBI guidelines and the Fair Practices Code. Responsibilities include visiting allocated customers, negotiating repayment plans, resolving queries, maintaining records, escalating disputed cases, and achieving monthly productivity/recovery/quality targets. Possession of a two-wheeler and valid driving licence is required. Job location: PAN India.

Digital Onboarding Specialist (Part-Time)

Assists walk-in branch customers in adopting the Bank's digital banking ecosystem — mobile banking, internet banking, UPI, and digital applications for FDs, RDs, loans, insurance, investment products, and credit cards. Also supports digital service requests (KYC updates, cheque books, nominee updates, etc.). This is a part-time role (6 hours, 10:30 AM–4:30 PM), open to freshers. Job location: PAN India.

Aadhaar Operator (Part-Time)

Performs Aadhaar enrolment and update processes, captures biometric data (fingerprints, iris scan, photograph), verifies identity documents, enters demographic details as per UIDAI standards, and maintains data privacy. Requires an active NSEIT certificate and basic computer/typing skills. Job location: PAN India, including AEC centres and enrolment camps.

Executive – Debit Card Operations / ATM-Reconciliation-Complaints

The job description document details a related "Executive – Debit Card Operations (Issuance/Reconciliation/Disputes)" profile under Digital Banking at Vadodara, matching the notice's separate Debit Card Operations role (10 posts). No separate detailed JD was found for the "Executive – ATM/Reconciliation/Complaints/Debit Cards" role (40 posts, Alkapuri, Vadodara) listed in the notice.

Sales Officer/ASM/RSM – Loan Sales

Covers day-to-day sales management for Home/Auto/Education/Tractor loans, including empanelling and developing sales teams, achieving sales/cross-sell targets through SO/SSO and dealer channels, managing client relationships, and ensuring compliance with NHB/RBI regulations. A Graduate degree is mandatory; minimum 3 years of relevant experience (ASM level) or 1–3 years (Direct Sales Executive level). Job location: PAN India, including Mumbai, Bengaluru, NCR, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Baroda.

Tele-Collection / Collections Executive

Manages large volumes of outbound calls for overdue payment collection, following communication scripts, identifying customer needs, and meeting individual/team collection targets. DRA certification is required; candidates should not be pursuing further studies. Experience required: minimum 0–5 years (varies by seniority — Executive/Senior Executive, Assistant Manager, or Trainer-level roles have differing experience requirements as detailed in the source JDs). Locations: GIFT City-Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Bangalore, and Manjalpur-Vadodara depending on the specific sub-role.

MIS Analyst / Contact Center MIS Executive

Manages data for client reporting, dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly), campaign and dialer data management, automation of reports, and statistical/performance feedback to operations. Requires graduation and advanced MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI). Job location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

Procurement Manager / Assistant Manager – Procurement

Executes procurement and tendering processes (e-Tendering via GeM, open/limited tenders, rate contracts), ensures compliance with GFR 2017, CVC guidelines, and internal procurement policy, supports vendor management, and maintains procurement MIS. Minimum Graduate required, MBA (Finance/Operations/Supply Chain) preferred, with minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Job location: Gift City, Gandhinagar.

Desktop Support Analyst / IT Support Engineer

Provides Level 1 & Level 2 technical support for hardware, software, and network issues; manages IT tickets, endpoint/asset management, Active Directory/Microsoft 365 administration, and network troubleshooting. Requires graduation plus CompTIA A+ or equivalent and Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (or equivalent) certifications, with minimum 3+ years of experience.

SBI SCO Application Fee

The application fee and intimation charges (non-refundable) are ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates; there is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Fees must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application, using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded or adjusted for any other examination or selection.

SBI SCO Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: mere fulfilment of minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the shortlisting committee decides the parameters and number of candidates called.
  • Interview: one or more rounds of personal, telephonic, or video interview, carrying 100 marks; the qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • CTC Negotiation: conducted individually with shortlisted candidates, at the time of interview or after completion of the interview process.
  • Merit List: prepared in descending order based on interview scores only; candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, in descending order.

How to Apply Online for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and download the detailed advertisement, CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23.
  2. Register online through the link provided, keeping a valid email ID active until the declaration of results.
  3. Scan and upload your latest photograph and signature as specified; the application will not register without these.
  4. Upload all relevant documents, including resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate, PwBD certificate (if applicable), educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, and biodata.
  5. Fill the application carefully, note the system-generated registration number and password, and pay the application fee online through the integrated payment gateway.
  6. Take a printout of the submitted application form and the fee e-receipt for your records; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Candidates should apply well before the closing date, 25-09-2026, to avoid last-minute technical issues. Hard copies of the application and documents need not be sent to the Bank.

SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for more than one post if they otherwise fulfil all eligibility criteria for each post.
  • Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi-Government offices, PSUs, Nationalized Banks, Financial Institutions, and SBI Group companies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Candidates previously issued offer letters in earlier Wealth Management & Premier Banking (WBPM) recruitment exercises but who did not join, or who previously resigned after being engaged on contract for posts in this advertisement, are debarred from applying for 2 years from the date of non-joining/resignation.
  • The call letter/interview advice will be sent by email only; no hard copy will be sent.
  • All revisions/corrigenda will be hosted on the Bank's website only.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely, or for any particular post, at any stage without assigning reasons.
  • Any legal proceedings arising from this recruitment fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Mumbai.

Quick Overview - SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026

The SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026 is a mark-sheet issued to every candidate who appeared in the Preliminary Examination, whether or not they qualified for the Mains stage. It shows the marks obtained in each section along with the total score and qualifying status. Prelims marks are used only for shortlisting candidates for the Mains exam and are not added to the final merit list.

SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026 Direct Link

The direct link to check the SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026 is active on the official SBI recruitment portal. Candidates should use only the official link below rather than unofficial third-party websites to avoid entering their details on unsafe pages.

SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026 - Official Download Link

Details Required to Check SBI PO Score Card 2026

Candidates need the following details ready before logging in to check their score card. Source reports on the exact second login field are inconsistent — some describe it as the account password, others as the date of birth. Keep both on hand to avoid a failed login attempt.

  • Registration Number or Roll Number (mandatory)
  • Password or Date of Birth, depending on the login screen displayed (see discrepancy note below)
  • Captcha / text verification code

How to Download SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.co.in and go to the Careers section.
  2. Click on "Current Openings" and find the Probationary Officer recruitment link (CRPD/PO/2026-27/09).
  3. Click on the "SBI PO Prelims Score Card 2026" or "Marks Secured by the Candidates in Preliminary Examination" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number or Roll Number.
  5. Enter your Password or Date of Birth, as prompted on screen.
  6. Enter the captcha/verification code and click Submit.
  7. Your SBI PO Prelims Score Card will appear on the screen.
  8. Check all details carefully and download or take a printout for future reference.

Important Instructions for SBI PO Score Card 2026

  • Use only the official SBI website or Careers portal to check and download your score card; avoid third-party links.
  • Keep your Registration Number/Roll Number, Date of Birth, and password handy before attempting to log in.
  • Cross-check the domain name in your browser address bar before entering personal details.
  • Download and save a copy of the score card for future reference, as it may be required at later stages of recruitment.
  • In case of login errors, this can occur due to incorrect details, heavy website traffic, or a temporary technical issue — wait and retry rather than repeatedly submitting incorrect information.
  • Report any factual error on your score card to SBI through the official grievance/contact channel rather than assuming it will self-correct.

SBI PO Mains Exam 2026: Next Step

Candidates shortlisted through the SBI PO Prelims Result 2026 will appear for the SBI PO Mains Examination scheduled on 12th September 2026. The Mains exam includes both an objective test and a descriptive paper, with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applicable to the objective section only. The SBI PO Mains Admit Card release date is Not Available Officially at the time of this update. Shortlisted candidates are advised to use their Prelims score card to identify weaker sections and focus preparation accordingly on reasoning, data analysis, English language, general/economy/banking awareness, and descriptive writing.

Corrigendum-1 Update (18.08.2026)

  • New post added: Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA), Level 6, Initial Pay ₹35,400, with 35 vacancies across RRB Bengaluru, Bhopal, Chennai, Guwahati and Patna.
  • CMA eligibility: B.Sc. degree with Physics and Chemistry (minimum 45% marks) in specified combinations, from a recognized University/Institute.

RRB JE/DMS/CMA Eligibility 2026

Junior Engineer & Depot Material Superintendent

Three-year Diploma in Engineering (or equivalent B.E./B.Tech) in the discipline relevant to the specific JE post opted for (see Annexure A of the CEN for post-wise qualification). DMS candidates need a three-year Diploma in Engineering in any discipline.

Exam Group Eligible Diploma/Degree Disciplines
Mechanical & Allied Engineering Mechanical, Production, Automobile, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Industrial, Machining, Tools & Machining, Tools & Die Making Engineering
Electrical & Allied Engineering Electrical Engineering (and sub-streams)
Electronics & Allied Engineering Electronics, Instrumentation & Control, Communication, Computer Science & Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology
Civil & Allied Engineering Civil Engineering, or B.Sc. in Civil Engineering (3-year duration)

Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) - added by Corrigendum-1

B.Sc. degree in Physics and Chemistry with a minimum of 45% marks from a recognized University/Institute, in any one of these combinations: (a) B.Sc. with Physics as major/specialization/Honours and Chemistry as a subject; (b) B.Sc. with Chemistry as major/specialization/Honours and Physics as a subject; or (c) B.Sc. with any other Science subject (including Mathematics/Mathematical Statistics) as major/specialization/Honours, with both Physics and Chemistry as subjects in the course.

RRB JE/DMS/CMA Selection Process 2026

Selection comprises four stages: 1st Stage CBT (CBT-I), 2nd Stage CBT (CBT-II), Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination (ME).

CBT-I (Common for all posts) - 90 minutes, 100 Questions

Section Questions / Marks
Mathematics 30
General Intelligence & Reasoning 25
General Awareness 15
General Science 30
Total 100

CBT-II - 120 minutes, 150 Questions

Section Questions / Marks
General Awareness 15
Physics & Chemistry 15
Basics of Computers and Applications 10
Basics of Environment and Pollution Control 10
Technical Abilities (post/exam group specific) 100
Total 150
  • Negative marking: ⅓ mark deducted for each wrong answer in both CBTs.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: UR & EWS 40%, OBC-NCL 30%, SC 30%, ST 25% (relaxable by up to 2 marks for PwBD candidates where PwBD vacancies are short of eligible candidates).
  • CBT-II shortlisting: 15 times the community-wise vacancy per RRB, based on CBT-I merit.
  • DV shortlisting: equal to the number of vacancies, based on CBT-II merit using a normalized Merit Index across Exam Groups.
  • A virtual calculator is provided on-screen during CBT-II only.

How to Apply for RRB JE/DMS/CMA Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB website or rrbapply.gov.in and Create an Account (mandatory personal mobile number and email ID; these cannot be changed later).
  2. Log in and select CEN No. 04/2026 (JE/DMS/CMA).
  3. Choose one RRB only and indicate zone/post preferences in order - this choice is final and cannot be changed.
  4. Fill in personal, educational and category details carefully.
  5. Complete live photo capture (webcam/front camera) as per the prescribed guidelines; upload signature (JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB).
  6. Upload SC/ST certificate (PDF, under 400 KB) if opting for free train travel facility.
  7. Pay the applicable examination fee online (internet banking / debit-credit card / UPI).
  8. Submit the application; note down your Registration Number.
  9. Use the modification window (16.09.2026 to 25.09.2026) if corrections are needed, on payment of ₹250 per modification.
Important: Multiple applications to different RRBs, or multiple applications to the same RRB, will lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams.

Documents Required

  • Educational qualification certificates (diploma/degree, as applicable to the post) with date of issue
  • Matriculation/10th certificate (for name, DOB, father's/mother's name)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/EBC), in prescribed Annexure format, from a competent authority
  • Ex-Servicemen declaration/employment certificate, where applicable
  • PwBD disability certificate and UDID, where applicable
  • Valid original photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, passport, driving licence, etc.)
  • Recent colour passport-size photograph and running-handwriting signature
  • NOC from present employer (for those serving in Government/PSU), where applicable

Important Conditions

  • Only one application per candidate against this CEN is permitted; multiple applications lead to rejection and debarment.
  • Vacancies are provisional and may increase, decrease, or become nil, per Railway Administration requirements.
  • A candidate with more than one qualifying discipline may choose only one Exam Group, and is then eligible only for posts mapped to that group.
  • Medical fitness as per the prescribed Medical Standard (A-3/B-1/B-2/C-1, as applicable to the post) is mandatory; no alternative appointment is given if found unfit.
  • Once a category/post/RRB is allotted, candidates forfeit the right to be considered for any other post/category in the same pay level.
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, or false information leads to lifetime debarment from RRB/RRC exams and possible legal action.

How to Raise an Objection Against the OPSC Answer Key 2026

  • Candidates who do not challenge or object to the provisional answer key will forfeit their right to raise the matter later in any forum or manner.
  • Questions for which no objection is received will be treated as final, and the provisional answer for those questions will stand as the final answer.
  • For questions where valid objections are received, the Final Answer Key will be decided by a Committee of Experts after examining the objections submitted.
  • The Commission is under no obligation to entertain objections that do not follow the prescribed format or reference.

Candidates who appeared for the exam can now check the Set-wise (A, B, C, D) answer key and raise objections online through the OPSC eChayan portal.

  • Last Date to Raise Objection/Suggestion: 17.09.2026

This detail is not mentioned in the official notice: the exact time by which the objection window closes on 17.09.2026 (e.g., a specific closing hour).

How to Raise an Objection Against the OPSC Answer Key

OPSC has laid down a specific, strict process for challenging the provisional answer key. Follow these steps carefully:

  1. Visit the objection portal: Go to opscechayan.in and locate the online objection module for this exam.
  2. Refer only to Set 'A': All objections must be submitted with reference to the Set 'A' Question Booklet only, regardless of which set you were actually given in the exam hall. Mention the Question Number of Set A only.
  3. Attach justification: Objections or suggestions must include sufficient justification for why a particular question or provisional answer is considered incorrect.
  4. Submit before the deadline: The online objection link will remain active only till 17.09.2026.
  5. Do not use any other mode: The notice explicitly states that objections submitted through any mode other than the online module will not be entertained under any circumstances.

Also Read: MH SET Exam Date 2026

Important Instructions From OPSC

  • Objections are accepted only on the correctness of questions and provisional answer keys, with sufficient justification. General complaints or unrelated queries will not be considered.
  • The Commission is under no obligation to entertain objections that do not follow the prescribed format or reference the wrong set.
  • Candidates who do not challenge the provisional answer key forfeit their right to raise the matter later, in any forum or in any other manner.
  • Questions for which no objections are received will have their provisional answer treated as the final answer.
  • For questions where valid objections are received, the Final Answer Key will be decided by a Committee of Experts after reviewing all submissions.

Documents Required to Check and Download RPSC SO Answer Key 2026

Keep the following details ready before logging in to check or download the answer key:

  • Date of Birth

If you intend to raise an objection against a specific question, you will additionally need:

How to Download RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026?

  1. Visit the official RPSC website: rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.

  3. Look for the link titled "Model Answer Key for Statistical Officer Exam 2025-26."

  5. Download and save the answer key PDF for future reference.
  6. Compare your recorded responses with the official answers to estimate your probable score.

How to Raise an Objection Against RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026?

Candidates who find a discrepancy in the provisional answer key can raise an objection online through the Rajasthan SSO Portal within the notified window of 8 to 10 September 2026 (till midnight). Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the SSO Rajasthan Portal: sso.rajasthan.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your SSO ID and password.
  3. Click on the "Recruitment Portal" app icon.
  4. Select the "Question Objection" link listed against the RPSC Statistical Officer Exam 2026.
  5. Match the questions strictly against the Master Question Paper released by RPSC.
  6. Select the question number you wish to challenge and enter your remarks.
  7. Upload authentic standard textbook proof in PDF format supporting your objection.
  8. Pay the non-refundable objection fee of ₹100 per question via E-Mitra, net banking, or debit card.
  9. Submit the objection form and save or print the confirmation/acknowledgement receipt.

Also Read: RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Mock Test Link 2026

RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026: Important Instructions

  • The answer key released on 7 September 2026 is provisional and subject to change based on objections received.
  • Objections must be submitted only within the notified window; late submissions are typically not entertained.
  • Objections should be matched against the Master Question Paper only, not against unofficial sources or coaching institute keys.
  • The objection fee is non-refundable, regardless of whether the objection is accepted or rejected.
  • The final answer key will be released only after RPSC reviews all valid objections received during the window.
  • The result will be prepared based on the final answer key, and the release date has not yet been announced.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

The ISS Examination 2026 Statistics papers for which the provisional answer key has been released are:

  • Statistics Paper I - Covers topics such as Probability, Statistical Methods, Numerical Analysis, and related areas.
  • Statistics Paper II - Covers topics including Linear Models, Statistical Inference, Sampling Theory, and Econometrics.

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.
